summary:
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — The IDEA/ALLEGRO vertex detector was refactored and the new FCC-SEED vertex detector option was added across FCC detector concepts, including a new CLD_o5_v01 variant, in [#612](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/612); users of ALLEGRO should note updated pixel resolutions and a Silicon Wrapper reduced to a single layer. The ALLEGRO HCAL Endcap pseudo-layer position calculation used by PandoraPFA was fixed in [#666](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/666), and the `dd4hep2root` utility now maps volumes to the closest predefined ROOT colours ([#662](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/662)).
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker)** — `DCHdigi_v02` has been renamed to `WireTrackerDigi_v01` and generalised to cover both drift-chamber and straw-tube-tracker digitisation, controlled by a new `isSTT` Gaudi property that switches the cellID encoding from `nphi` to `tube`+`sector` ([#100](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/100)). The GenFit interface was updated in the same PR so track fitting no longer crashes with the renamed digitiser; downstream steering files must migrate to the new algorithm name.
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — ALLEGRO and IDEA `run_digi_reco.py` scripts were fixed for the `DCHdigi_v02` → `WireTrackerDigi_v01` rename ([#395](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/395)), and the STT digitiser was wired into the ALLEGRO reconstruction chain, selectable via the `isSTT` property, together with a `WireTrackerName` fix to keep GenFit track fitting working ([#388](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/388)). The IDEA Delphes and EDM4hep steering cards were restored on `main` and the ZH/ZZ/WW Pythia8 generator cards refreshed to the `winter2023` versions ([#393](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/393)); additionally track validation options were exposed for IDEA and ctests for both IDEA and ALLEGRO ([#386](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/386)).
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — The deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload is now hidden from Cling/cppyy to prevent Python bindings from selecting the wrong overload ([#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524)).
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — Several ACTS API updates were absorbed: propagator and grid-bin-finder call sites were adapted ([#98](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/98)), the EDM4hep material-map plugin now supports the new `TrackingGeometryMaterial` struct while retaining backwards compatibility ([#104](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/104)), and material binning switched to `AxisSpec` ([#102](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/102)). The GNN track finder gained a `SortEdges` flag to re-orient edges outward-from-IP to match the ACORN training convention ([#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/103)), and `--compactFile` is now required in the CKF, GNN and geometry-visualisation option scripts, producing a clear error instead of a cryptic Gaudi failure ([#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/97)).
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — `k4run` now accepts `--evt-max` as an alias for `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax`, making the event-limit option easier to discover ([#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431)).
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes)** — Photon direction (`ITheta`, `IPhi`) and its pointing/position uncertainties (`directionError`, `positionError` with `errorPhi`/`errorTheta`) are now written by the Delphes-to-EDM4hep converter ([#161](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/161)), requiring a bumped Delphes version (tag `3.5.2pre02`).
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — The DDCAD ASSIMP/CSG-based exporter was removed because ROOT made `RCsg`/`CsgOps.h` private ([#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681)); this is a user-visible loss of CAD export functionality (the maintainer plans to restore it via a public-ROOT-API reimplementation in a follow-up).
- **[key4hep/key4hep-spack](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack)** — A dedicated setup script for the fish shell is now installed alongside the existing one ([#922](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack/pull/922)).
- **[key4hep/k4geo (MuColl)](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/658)** — Not FCC; see Omitted.
